critique: The metaphor of schedule blocks as physical objects on a riverbank creates strong visceral appeal and conceptual clarity, but the execution undermines usability through poor contrast between the dark purple blocks and their white text, while the 'NOW' indicator gets lost against the light background. The dimensional perspective adds visual interest but sacrifices the precise time alignment that makes calendars behaviorally effective, creating ambiguity about when events actually start and end relative to the time axis.
